alt: Anterior and lateral view of the right leg labelling the anterior compartment (tibialis anterior, extensor digitorum longus, extensor hallucis longus, fibularis tertius) and the lateral compartment (fibularis longus and brevis), together with the superior and inferior extensor retinacula. The posterior compartment (gastrocnemius, soleus, tibialis posterior) is not shown.
caption: Anterior and lateral compartments of the leg (OpenStax): tibialis anterior, extensor digitorum longus, extensor hallucis longus and fibularis tertius (dorsiflexors, deep fibular nerve) with fibularis longus and brevis (evertors, superficial fibular nerve). The posterior compartment is not shown.
